mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_platform_recovery_code SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', superseded_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE platform_identity_id = #{platformIdentityId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_platform_recovery_code ( platform_identity_id, batch_id, code_hash, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{platformIdentityId}, #{batchId}, #{codeHash}, #{status}, #{platformIdentityId}, #{platformIdentityId} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform_identity_id, batch_id, code_hash, status, version FROM public.auth_platform_recovery_code WHERE platform_identity_id = #{platformIdentityId} AND code_hash = #{codeHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_platform_recovery_code SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
